accepted_motifs.falsifier: Remove the band and check whether the chosen route and cumulative risk remain unchanged for every sampled start.
accepted_motifs.hypothesis: A narrow diagonal plume should make a risk-aware planner detour even when the geometric route is shorter.

accepted_motifs.falsifier: Find a state where the added front cannot affect any path to a goal within 256 moves, yet its removal changes the selected action.
accepted_motifs.hypothesis: A second crossing front creates cases where longer-horizon planning must compare interacting detours.

accepted_motifs.falsifier: Check whether all cells marked as debris have the same cost as their non-debris neighbors after canonical expansion.
accepted_motifs.hypothesis: Sparse debris zones add local choices that distinguish one-step greed from longer planning.

accepted_motifs.falsifier: Verify that cells outside the declared one-cell corridor receive no relief from this motif.
accepted_motifs.hypothesis: Regular north-south evacuation lanes should provide transparent low-risk alternatives through hazard bands.

accepted_motifs.falsifier: Verify that cells outside the declared one-cell corridor receive no relief from this motif.
accepted_motifs.hypothesis: Regular east-west evacuation lanes create composable crossings with the north-south lanes.

authorship.role: Proposed abstractions, scenario motifs, edge cases, and falsifiers. It did not assign Q-values or certify outcomes.

edge_cases: A start state may already be a terminal safe haven.
A move at a boundary remains in place and receives an explicit penalty.
Equal Q-values use the frozen north, east, south, west tie-break order.
A short horizon may rationally reduce immediate risk without reaching a safe haven.
A longer horizon may reverse the short-horizon action when the terminal reward becomes reachable.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Scatter hash-selected impassable walls through the map.
quarantined_proposals.reason: The proposal can create disconnected or trapped states, so a failed rollout would mix planner quality with generator reachability.
quarantined_proposals.reconsider_if: A connectivity certificate or constructive maze generator is added.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Ask the language model to write the target Q-value for every generated scenario.
quarantined_proposals.reason: The same fallible proposer would become its own outcome oracle, making the evidence circular.
quarantined_proposals.reconsider_if: Labels are independently checked against a simulator, formal model, measured outcome, or human preference protocol.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Allow generated Python expressions to define arbitrary rewards.
quarantined_proposals.reason: Unrestricted code would weaken determinism, reviewability, and the input safety boundary.
quarantined_proposals.reconsider_if: Expressions are compiled from a finite typed DSL with resource bounds and differential tests.

quarantined_proposals.proposal: Merge states that share distance-to-goal even when their hazard levels differ.
quarantined_proposals.reason: The abstraction can alias a safe route with a hazardous route and silently change the greedy action.
quarantined_proposals.reconsider_if: A checked action-equivalence or bounded-regret certificate covers every merged state.

state_abstractions.failure_mode: Coordinates alone do not transfer to a changed map.
state_abstractions.meaning: A canonical row-major grid coordinate identifies each finite state.

state_abstractions.failure_mode: A local risk score does not reveal hazards beyond the next move.
state_abstractions.meaning: Each action exposes the deterministic risk of its destination cell.

state_abstractions.failure_mode: Distance alone misses the cost of crossing risk bands.
state_abstractions.meaning: Regular safe-haven locations create a bounded but nontrivial routing objective.

state_abstractions.failure_mode: Using the wrong layer changes the objective being optimized.
state_abstractions.meaning: The layer index records how many decisions remain.
